Treasurer Office
Garfield County
Nebraska
Contact
Tamara L. Hitchcock
Treasurer
308-346-4125
308-346-4083 – Fax
treasurer@garfieldcountyne.gov
Office Hours
Monday thru Friday
8:30am – 12:30pm
1:00pm – 4:00pm
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Mailing Address
PO Box 511
Burwell, NE 68823
Location
250 South 8th
Burwell, NE 68823
Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Title and Register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
Take collections for Nebraska Department of Motor Vehicles for business conducted with examiner.
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
